guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice_cpu rose from 0.4289 to 18.2902 (+4165%, z=+226), far above every other series, with smaller memory (+38%) and socket (+22%) increases, while no other service's metrics moved. Confidence is held at medium because checkoutservice_latency-50 barely changed (+5.7%), the worst traces mostly traverse frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice with errors in frontendservice, and there are no warning or error logs to corroborate.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the checkoutservice pods for the CPU hot loop (profile, recent deploy) and restart or roll back the affected pod if confirmed; review CPU requests and limits only after the cause is understood. Also check why traces through currencyservice show errors in frontendservice.
